shortDescription: The Supreme Court has allowed the settlement between the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) in the long-running co-location and dark-fibre matters, bringing the exchange’s decade-old regulatory overhang to a close.This is a developing story

children: The Supreme Court has allowed the settlement between the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) in the long-running co-location and dark-fibre matters, bringing the exchange’s decade-old regulatory overhang to a close.

title: Supreme Court allows all co-location cases to be settled between SEBI and NSE
